errors.description: Model correctly identified Option D as the answer, but for the wrong reasons — it matched a misperceived cube configuration to Option D, which actually corresponds to Cube 1 in the ground truth (red front, blue top, green right).

analysis_result.analysis: The model made a critical perception error by misidentifying the color configuration of the reference cube (red top/green front instead of blue top/red front). Despite this, it coincidentally selected the correct option (D) by matching its misperceived cube to Option D — which in reality matches the correct reference cube. This is a case of LUCKY_GUESS masked by faulty reasoning: the final answer is correct, but the reasoning is built on hallucinated attributes and incorrect grounding.
